jobs.description:
Faculty Positions in Physics and Astronomy National Tsing Hua
   University, Taiwan

   (located in Hsinchu – the heart of Taiwan’s science and tech hub)

   ---------------------------------------------------------------------

   Job Summary
   The Department of Physics and Institute of Astronomy at National Tsing
   Hua University invites applications for full-time faculty positions at
   the rank of Assistant Professor or higher, with appointments starting
   in February or August 2027. We are interested in candidates in all
   fields of physics, particularly quantum computing, or Atomic,
   Molecular, and Optical (AMO) physics.

   Application Deadlines

     * First round: August 15, 2026 (Appointment starting February 1 or
       August 1, 2027)

     * Second round: October 31, 2026 (Appointment starting August 1,
       2027)

   ---------------------------------------------------------------------

   About the Department
   National Tsing Hua University (NTHU), one of Taiwan's premier research
   institutions, consistently ranks within the top 85 globally according
   to QS subject rankings. The Department of Physics and Institute of
   Astronomy at NTHU hosts more than 50 distinguished faculty members
   conducting cutting-edge theoretical and experimental research. Our
   department is home to a government-funded Center for Quantum Science
   and Technology, emphasizing our commitment to innovative and impactful
   research.

   We provide comprehensive undergraduate tracks in Physics, Optics and
   Photonics, and Astrophysics, along with advanced graduate programs in
   Physics, Applied Physics, and Optical Physics, preparing students to
   excel at the forefront of science and technology.

   Research areas include:

     * Experimental and Theoretical Condensed Matter Physics: strongly
       correlated systems, spintronics, nanodevices, ultrafast and
       nonlinear optics, surface physics, high-temperature
       superconductivity, soft matter, synchrotron applications

     * Atomic, Molecular, and Optical Physics: Quantum metrology, quantum
       optics, precision laser spectroscopy, Quantum Gas.

     * Plasma Physics: electron cyclotron masers, high-power sub-THz
       sources

     * Astrophysics: solar physics, star and planet formation, compact
       objects, high-energy astrophysics

     * Experimental and Theoretical Particle Physics: supersymmetric
       particles, CP violation, neutrino physics, extra dimensions,
       particle astrophysics, and cosmology

   The department is committed to advancing interdisciplinary research
   and international collaboration, with ongoing developments in quantum
   optics, nanoscience, computational physics, and soft matter. We also
   maintain a close partnership with the Institute of Photonics
   Technologies at our university.

   In addition, the Center for Quantum Technology, established in 2018 at
   National Tsing Hua University, integrates experts and technologies in
   quantum materials and quantum information from across departments,
   colleges, and institutions in Taiwan. With strong international
   collaborations, the center leads efforts to develop key technologies
   for the forthcoming second quantum revolution. By leveraging the
   department's strengths in quantum systems based on cold atoms and
   photons, alongside cutting-edge achievements in solid-state quantum
   materials, the center aims to create highly applicable platforms for
   quantum computing and quantum communication.

   ---------------------------------------------------------------------

   Responsibilities

     * Conduct original research in physics or astronomy

     * Teach undergraduate and graduate-level courses in English

     * Supervise students and contribute to academic service

   ---------------------------------------------------------------------

   Qualifications

     * Ph.D. in physics, astronomy, or a closely related field

     * Demonstrated research excellence or strong potential

     * Ability to teach in English (Chinese proficiency is a plus)

   ---------------------------------------------------------------------

   Application Instructions Applicants should submit the following
   materials:

     * Curriculum vitae (including ORCID ID)

     * Publication list

     * Up to five representative publications

     * Research and teaching statements

     * At least three recommendation letters (to be sent directly by
       referees)

   All application materials and recommendation letters should be emailed
   to:
   ✉️ personnel@phys.nthu.edu.tw
   (Subject: “Application for Faculty Position – [Your Name]”)
   Recommendation letters: (Subject: “Recommendation for [Applicant’s
   Name]”)

   ---------------------------------------------------------------------

   More Information
